headline: Wholesale
prices
surged 1.3%
in September
slides.subtitle:
Producer prices rose 6.3%
from a year ago

slides.title: What happened
slides.body: The Producer Price Index for final demand rose 1.3% in September and 6.3% over 12 months. Energy led the jump.

slides.title: The numbers
slides.subtitle: PPI, September, % change from August
slides.body: Core PPI rose 0.5% in the month.

slides.title: Why it matters
slides.body: Producer prices track what businesses pay. Higher input costs can feed into consumer prices and keep the Fed cautious.
